phaseBaseline.note: Taken at the start of Phase 7 and again before the first vault device run; identical to Phase 6D.

what_happened: During a manual exploration of the system file picker (DocumentsUI) from an isolated QA-package test, an adb input tap did not return. qemu-system-x86_64 used 0 CPU seconds over 5 s, was reported as not responding, and adb shell timed out. Host free memory was about 2.1 GB.
steps: Stopped the Unified Test Platform Java process and two stuck adb client processes; no Gradle daemon was running.
Stopped the hung emulator and started the same AVD with its original flags: -no-snapshot-load -no-snapshot-save (cold boot from the current disk; no snapshot rollback).
Cleared data of the isolated QA package in.jansetu.app.qa only, to remove the interrupted test's temporary vault. Nothing was cleared, uninstalled, reseeded or installed in in.jansetu.app.
result: All four protected preview hashes are identical. This is the third emulator hang (see phase6b- and phase6c-emulator-restart.json).
